evidence.observation: Early growth oxygen was 8.4 ppm and pressure 3.095 Torr.
Oxygen rose to 17.1 ppm and pressure to 3.151 Torr.
Oxygen and pressure continued rising to 22.9 ppm and 3.210 Torr.
Oxygen reached 30.8 ppm and pressure 3.266 Torr despite stable argon flow at 100.6 sccm and temperature at 749.9 C; controller still reports running.

args.missing_evidence: A leak-integrity check and exhaust-conductance check are needed to distinguish suspected air ingress from other causes of the oxygen/pressure rise; sample characterization is not yet available.
